en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washa, from Ahmad Bin A’iz, from Ibn Azina, from Al Fuzayl Bin Yasar who said,
‘One day Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> initiated us saying: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
The one who dies and there isn’t an Imam<sup>asws</sup> over him, so his death would be a death of the ignorance (Pre-Islamic era)’.
So I said, ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said that?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, he<sup>saww</sup> has said that?’
I said, ‘So everyone who dies and there isn’t an Imam<sup>asws</sup> for him, so his death would be the death of the ignorance (Pre-Islamic period)?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.
